						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_case
						RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_state
						RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_choice
						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						EXPECTED_STATE = 5
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 2
					}
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_case
						RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_state
						RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_choice
						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						EXPECTED_STATE = 5
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
					}
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_operation_total
						has_variable = zg361_we_operation_used
					}
					var:zg361_we_operation_used < var:zg361_we_operation_total
					trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m361_future_install_pending } var:zg361_we_m361_future_install_pending = 0 } trigger_else = { always = yes }
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 3613 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 } # typed RED, no receipt or business write
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_al_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_al_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_al_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_al_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_al_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_al_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = 5
			}
			zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
				RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_owner
				RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_subject
				RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_cycle
				RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_case
				RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_state
				RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_choice
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = 5
				EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 2 } # idempotent no-op
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_al_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_al_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_al_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_al_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_al_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_al_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = 5
			}
			OR = {
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 5
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 1
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 5
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 2
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m361_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 5
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 3619 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 } # route collision typed RED
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 3 } } # stale no-op
}
